phase_name: Phase 15-8 receiver_validator_permission Measurement Execution Record Template
phase_japanese_name: Phase 15-8 receiver_validator_permission 測定実行記録テンプレート
purpose: Design the authoritative execution record template for Phase 15-8 receiver_validator_permission measurement workflow, providing a structured capture format for measurement inputs, execution steps, results, and post-measurement state transition record

template_usage_notes.when_to_use: Fill this template at the time Phase 15-8 measurement workflow actually executes (after Phase 18-8 AUTHORIZE_FULL or AUTHORIZE_PHASE_15_8_ONLY is signed and Phase 18-6 final ABORT verification passes)
template_usage_notes.template_status: DESIGN_TEMPLATE (not yet filled; actual execution not yet authorized)
template_usage_notes.filling_authority: Authority who signed Phase 18-8 launch authorization (or explicitly delegated role)
template_usage_notes.phase_15_7_dependency_note: In sequential execution mode, Phase 15-7 must complete with GO result before Phase 15-8 executes. In parallel mode, Phase 15-8 may execute independently.

section_1_execution_preamble.description: Record of execution preconditions and gate clearance immediately before measurement

phase_18_8_authorization_reference.description: signed_authorization_id from Phase 18-8 that authorized this execution

phase_15_7_execution_record_id.description: If sequential: EXEC_PHASE15_7_... reference. If parallel: null.

phase_15_7_integrated_decision_result.description: If sequential: must be GO before Phase 15-8 executes. If parallel: NOT_YET_EXECUTED allowed.

integrated_decision_before.description: May be GO (if Phase 15-7 completed with GO in sequential mode) or NO_GO (if parallel or Phase 15-7 not yet run)

receiver_validator_permission_before.description: Must be NOT_EFFECTIVE immediately before Phase 15-8 execution

section_2_measurement_scope_definition.description: Definition of what receiver_validator_permission measures and what criteria govern EFFECTIVE/NOT_EFFECTIVE outcome

measurement_target.template_value: Evaluate whether the receiver_validator component has the correct permissions and implementation to become EFFECTIVE for generic_block_ai app/tests implementation

measurement_method.template_value: Evaluate 6 gate conditions from Phase 17-3 (receiver_validator_permission feasibility gates) against current system state and receiver_validator implementation

effective_criteria.description: Conditions that must ALL be true for receiver_validator_permission = EFFECTIVE

criteria.criterion: Phase 17-3 Gate 1: Phase 16 receipt status confirmed (RECEIPT_CONFIRMED)
Phase 17-3 Gate 2: Phase 17-1 action is PROCEED or CAUTION_APPROVED
Phase 17-3 Gate 3: Phase 16-3 feasibility is READY_1, READY_2, or CAUTION_APPROVED
Phase 17-3 Gate 4: receiver_validator_permission is currently NOT_EFFECTIVE (not yet changed)
Phase 17-3 Gate 5: All receiver_validator blocking conditions cleared (no implementation_change detected)
Phase 17-3 Gate 6 (observational): receiver_validator implementation matches design specification
criteria.note: Gate 6 is observational (blocking=false in Phase 17-3), but result is recorded

not_effective_criteria.description: If any of these are true, receiver_validator_permission remains NOT_EFFECTIVE

criteria.criterion: receiver_validator implementation_change detected since Phase 18-3 check
Any Phase 17-3 blocking gate (Gates 1-5) in HOLD or HALT status
Phase 18-3 check status HOLD_PENDING or HALT_BLOCKERS
Phase 18-6 ABORT condition detected at execution time

section_3_measurement_execution_steps.description: Step-by-step execution log for Phase 15-8 measurement

steps.action: Open audit trail for Phase 15-8 execution. Record execution_record_id and start timestamp.
Verify Phase 15-7 dependency state (sequential: must have GO result; parallel: record NOT_YET_EXECUTED)
Inspect receiver_validator implementation: compare code/config against design specification
Evaluate Phase 17-3 gate conditions (6 gates) for receiver_validator_permission feasibility
Apply EFFECTIVE/NOT_EFFECTIVE criteria and determine receiver_validator_permission value
Record determined receiver_validator_permission value and compute evidence hash
Close Phase 15-8 execution audit trail. Record end timestamp and final status.

section_4_measurement_result.description: Final result of Phase 15-8 receiver_validator_permission measurement

receiver_validator_permission_result.description: Result of Phase 15-8 measurement. Changes receiver_validator_permission state if EFFECTIVE.

result_evidence_hash_sha256_plus.description: SHA-256+ hash of section_3 execution steps and section_4 results

integrated_decision_after.description: Unchanged by Phase 15-8 (only Phase 15-7 can change this)
integrated_decision_after.note: Reflects Phase 15-7 result if already executed, else remains NO_GO

receiver_validator_permission_after.description: If measurement result=EFFECTIVE, transitions from NOT_EFFECTIVE to EFFECTIVE

app_implementation_status_after.description: If integrated_decision=GO AND receiver_validator_permission=EFFECTIVE → transitions to GO. Otherwise remains NO_GO.

section_5_post_measurement_actions.description: Required actions after Phase 15-8 measurement completes

actions.action: Store execution record (this document) in immutable audit trail
Notify authority of measurement result via secure channel
Proceed to Phase 19-3 (Phase 15-7/15-8 result consistency confirmation) regardless of result
If both integrated_decision=GO AND receiver_validator_permission=EFFECTIVE confirmed in Phase 19-3: Proceed to Phase 20+ for app/tests implementation unlock
If receiver_validator_permission=NOT_EFFECTIVE: Document reason, escalate to Phase 18-5 HOLD/HALT procedure

phase_19_2_completion_criteria: Pre-execution preamble fields (Phase 15-7 dependency, state snapshot, authorization references) defined
Measurement scope (EFFECTIVE criteria from Phase 17-3, NOT_EFFECTIVE criteria) defined
7-step execution log (including Phase 15-7 dependency check and receiver_validator implementation inspection) designed
Measurement result and post-measurement state transition fields (including dual-gate condition) defined
No changes to app/ or tests/ directories
